script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Lot Eyes the Plain” takes place where Lot is looking from, not at Zoar; Zoar is a landmark he sees in the distance.
“Kings Go to War” describes the king of Zoar joining the other kings for battle in the Valley of Siddim, not an event at Zoar.

“A Town Spared for Lot” suggests Zoar was named because Lot was told to hurry. The reason is connected to the town’s small size. Include Genesis 19:20 to tell that part. Also, verse 23 says Lot had reached Zoar by the time the sun had risen, not necessarily at sunrise.

“Moses Sees the Land” takes place on the mountain, not at Zoar; Zoar is part of the region shown to Moses. The passage describes the region from the Valley of Jericho to Zoar, not the full extent of the promised land.
